integrity: All statements concern exact Keplerian integrals; finite seeded numerical checks are reproducibility tests, not exhaustive verification or independent auditing.
scientific_limitations: Only ideal two-body Kepler motion at fixed semimajor axis, point-source inverse-square irradiation, and fixed above-circular flux threshold are treated. No atmosphere, habitability, collision/stability limits or stellar evolution is modeled. Prior general time-in-zone algorithms exist. Exact optimality and opposite dose ordering may be implicit in broader orbital-insolation theorems.
title: Opposite eccentricity rankings for high-irradiance duration and excess dose
